formats.key: addLiquidity(address tokenA,address tokenB,uint256 amountADesired,uint256 amountBDesired,uint256 amountAMin,uint256 amountBMin,address to,uint256 deadline)
effects: The signer sends between amountAMin and amountADesired of tokenA to the pair, the exact amount set by the pool ratio.
The signer sends between amountBMin and amountBDesired of tokenB to the pair.
The pair mints LP tokens (UNI-V2) to `to`, in an amount set by the pool.
The pair is created when it does not exist yet.
formats.shown: Add up to amountADesired tokenA and up to amountBDesired tokenB, the minimums for both, the LP recipient and the deadline.

findings.title: addLiquidity shows no amount for the LP tokens received, because the pool decides it.
findings.evidence: UniswapV2Router02.addLiquidity: `liquidity = IUniswapV2Pair(pair).mint(to);` has no minimum in the calldata. The descriptor shows only `to` 'Recipient'.

formats.key: addLiquidityETH(address token,uint256 amountTokenDesired,uint256 amountTokenMin,uint256 amountETHMin,address to,uint256 deadline)
effects: The signer sends msg.value of native ETH to the router.
The router wraps between amountETHMin and msg.value of that ETH into WETH and sends it to the pair. It refunds the rest to the signer.
The signer sends between amountTokenMin and amountTokenDesired of the token to the pair.
The pair mints LP tokens (UNI-V2) to `to`, in an amount set by the pool.
The pair is created when it does not exist yet.
formats.shown: 'Add Liquidity' with the maximum and minimum token amounts, 'Minimum ETH to Add', the recipient and the deadline. No field shows the ETH that the signer sends.

findings.title: addLiquidityETH is payable but has no @.value field, so the screen never shows the ETH sent.
findings.evidence: UniswapV2Router02.addLiquidityETH is `external virtual override payable` and passes `msg.value` as amountBDesired to _addLiquidity. The descriptor fields are amountTokenDesired, amountTokenMin, amountETHMin, to, deadline and token, with no `@.value`. Case 0: native 0.5 ETH goes from the signer to the router with signer=out. The screen shows only 'Minimum ETH to Add: 0.5 ETH'.
findings.fix: Add `{"path": "@.value", "label": "Maximum ETH to Add", "format": "amount"}` and keep `{@.value}` in interpolatedIntent.

findings.title: addLiquidityETH shows only 'Minimum ETH to Add', so the reader takes a minimum for the ETH sent.
findings.evidence: Case 0: the screen shows 'Minimum ETH to Add: 0.5 ETH'. The reader wrote 'At least 0.5 ETH ... the actual ETH sent could be higher' and 'Maximum ETH to add isn't shown'. The mined transaction sent exactly 0.5 ETH (msg.value).
findings.fix: Show `@.value` as 'Maximum ETH to Add' next to 'Minimum ETH to Add'.

findings.title: addLiquidityETH interpolatedIntent uses {@.value}, which is not a field, and the screen drops the sentence.
findings.evidence: descriptor interpolatedIntent: "Add up to {amountTokenDesired} and up to {@.value} as liquidity". No field has the path `@.value`. The case 0 screen shows only the intent 'Add Liquidity'.
findings.fix: Add the `@.value` field so the sentence can render.

findings.title: addLiquidityETH shows no amount for the LP tokens received, because the pool decides it.
findings.evidence: UniswapV2Router02.addLiquidityETH: `liquidity = IUniswapV2Pair(pair).mint(to);`. Case 0: the signer receives 62048.37 UNI-V2 (signer=in), and no amount is on the screen.

cases.notes: Effects: 0.5 ETH out (not shown, only the 0.5 ETH minimum), 7.7e9 ERIREF out (shown as maximum and minimum), 62048 UNI-V2 in to the signer (recipient shown, the amount cannot be bound). The reader took the ETH minimum for the ETH sent and flagged the maximum as unknown.

formats.key: removeLiquidity(address tokenA,address tokenB,uint256 liquidity,uint256 amountAMin,uint256 amountBMin,address to,uint256 deadline)
effects: The signer sends `liquidity` LP tokens of the tokenA/tokenB pair to the pair. This uses an existing allowance to the router.
The pair burns them and sends at least amountAMin tokenA and amountBMin tokenB to `to`.
formats.shown: Remove the LP amount for at least the minimum of each token, with the recipient and the deadline.

formats.key: removeLiquidityETH(address token,uint256 liquidity,uint256 amountTokenMin,uint256 amountETHMin,address to,uint256 deadline)
effects: The signer sends `liquidity` LP tokens of the token/WETH pair to the pair. This uses an existing allowance to the router.
At least amountTokenMin of the token goes to `to`.
The router unwraps at least amountETHMin WETH and sends it as native ETH to `to`.
formats.shown: Remove the LP amount for at least the token minimum and the ETH minimum, with the recipient and the deadline.

formats.key: removeLiquidityETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens(address token,uint256 liquidity,uint256 amountTokenMin,uint256 amountETHMin,address to,uint256 deadline)
effects: The signer sends `liquidity` LP tokens of the token/WETH pair to the pair. This uses an existing allowance to the router.
The router sends its whole token balance to `to`. The burn must give at least amountTokenMin before any transfer fee, so `to` can get less.
The router unwraps at least amountETHMin WETH and sends it as native ETH to `to`.
formats.shown: Remove the LP amount for at least the ETH minimum and the token minimum 'before token fees', with the recipient and the deadline.

findings.title: removeLiquidityETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens cannot bound the token received after the token's own transfer fee.
findings.evidence: UniswapV2Router02.removeLiquidityETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens: `TransferHelper.safeTransfer(token, to, IERC20(token).balanceOf(address(this)));` and amountTokenMin is checked in removeLiquidity before this transfer. The label 'Minimum Before Fees' states this.

formats.key: removeLiquidityETHWithPermit(address token,uint256 liquidity,uint256 amountTokenMin,uint256 amountETHMin,address to,uint256 deadline,bool approveMax,uint8 v,bytes32 r,bytes32 s)
effects: A permit sets the signer's LP allowance to the router: unlimited when approveMax is true, else `liquidity`.
The signer sends `liquidity` LP tokens to the pair.
At least amountTokenMin of the token and at least amountETHMin native ETH go to `to`.
formats.shown: Remove the LP amount for at least the token and ETH minimums, the recipient, the deadline and the LP approval ('Unlimited to router' or 'This removal only').

formats.key: removeLiquidityETHWithPermitSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens(address token,uint256 liquidity,uint256 amountTokenMin,uint256 amountETHMin,address to,uint256 deadline,bool approveMax,uint8 v,bytes32 r,bytes32 s)
effects: A permit sets the signer's LP allowance to the router: unlimited when approveMax is true, else `liquidity`.
The signer sends `liquidity` LP tokens to the pair.
The router sends its whole token balance to `to`. The minimum applies before the transfer fee.
At least amountETHMin native ETH goes to `to`.
formats.shown: Remove the LP amount for at least the ETH minimum and the token minimum before fees, the recipient, the deadline and the LP approval.

findings.title: removeLiquidityETHWithPermitSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens cannot bound the token received after the transfer fee.
findings.evidence: UniswapV2Router02.removeLiquidityETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens (called by this function) sends `IERC20(token).balanceOf(address(this))` after the minimum check. The descriptor labels it 'Minimum Before Fees'.

formats.key: removeLiquidityWithPermit(address tokenA,address tokenB,uint256 liquidity,uint256 amountAMin,uint256 amountBMin,address to,uint256 deadline,bool approveMax,uint8 v,bytes32 r,bytes32 s)
effects: A permit sets the signer's LP allowance to the router: unlimited when approveMax is true, else `liquidity`.
The signer sends `liquidity` LP tokens to the pair.
At least amountAMin tokenA and amountBMin tokenB go to `to`.
formats.shown: Remove the LP amount for at least both token minimums, the recipient, the deadline and the LP approval.
